messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: page fired for service=hotvector-serve severity=critical — 5xx > 10% (now 18%) in eu-west-1. Pager: pd-ops.
Maria: taking this — acked the PD page. pulling logs now.
Jonas: on call for infra, standing by for handoff if needed. what region is first?
Maria: eu-west-1 is worst, us-west-2 minor blips. embedding / chat routes both hit. customer-facing error spike, some retries returning 504s.
Priya: jumping in — last deploy to hotvector-serve was a quantization change 09:05 UTC, flagged in deploy logs. could be regressed model path.
Sam: logs look like KV cache misses + OOM restarts on a subset of pods. attaching quick grep:
Sam: ```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=hotvector-serve -o wide
kubectl -n inference logs hotvector-serve-5f9b -c inference | tail -n 200
# observed repeated: "CUDA out of memory" then 500 responses
```
Alex: healthcheck endpoint returns 200 but inference endpoints return 500s. probably failing at model load path after quantization convo.
Maria: mitigation plan: 1) scale up dedicated pool + autoscale to drain errors, 2) route traffic to fallback model variant (hotvector-v1-safe), 3) rollback quantization deploy if quick. I'm starting 1 & 2.
Jonas: I can do autoscaler bump and create a temporary route. doing: `kubectl patch hautoscaler hotvector --patch '{"spec":{"minReplicas":10}}'`
Priya: I can flip the route in the routing layer: redirect /v1/embed -> hotvector-v1-safe and reduce batch size at ingress. ETA ~4m.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Maria acknowledged the page (7081234568).
Maria: confirmed I bound a canary route to v1-safe for eu-west-1 and added header-based fallback for retries. Numbers already improving? pls post metrics.
Sam: metrics: 5xx down from 18% -> 6% in the last 90s. latency up slightly but success rate improving. requests per minute impacted ~ 1.2k (peak).
Alex: customer-impact note: Hosted API customers in eu-west-1 seeing failures on embed and chat. Top 5 customers cumulatively ~30% of hit. Support pinged (cc: @oncall-support).
Jonas: autoscaler bumped, new nodes coming up. I'm evicting failing pods gracefully: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/hotvector-serve -n inference` on the older nodes only.
Priya: disabled batching on the inference gateway for hotvector routes to reduce OOM pressure.
Maria: handing off primary ownership to Jonas for infra actions and to Priya for routing/rollback. I'm staying on thread for customer comms.
Jonas: taking primary ownership for mitigation. will escalate to infra escalation if we see >10% 5xx again after 10m.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: ownership transferred: Maria -> Jonas (7081234575).
Sam: quick check: rolling back quantization patch is blocked by dependency on internal tokenizer change — rollback risk high. recommend keep routing fallback and autoscale while we patch a hotfix.
Priya: agreed. hotfix plan: disable quantization flag and re-deploy a micro-release (v2.0.1-hotfix). prepping change now.
Maria: customer comms draft: "We're investigating elevated 5xx errors in eu-west-1 affecting embeddings and chat. Traffic has been routed to a fallback model and autoscaling increased. We're monitoring and will update in 15 minutes." Thoughts?
Alex: LGTM, add ETA window and ask customers to retry after 10s backoff.
Maria: posted to support channel and updated status page (minor degraded).
Sam: metric update 5m in: 5xx at 3.2%, success rate stabilizing, p99 latency +120ms.
Jonas: infra healthy to sustain for now. I'll keep loop open until 30m stable or until hotfix deploy.
Priya: hotfix built and running in staging smoke. rolling to eu-west-1 canary now.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation window set: auto-escalate if unresolved >30m.
Maria: note — if hotfix fails, plan B: increase fallback split to 100% and throttle non-critical batch endpoints.
Sam: can we confirm no data loss? embeddings retry is idempotent; no customer data deleted.
Alex: support ticket template queued for impacted customers with unique request ids and mitigation steps.
Jonas: hotfix successful on canary. starting gradual rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100%. watching error rate.
Priya: turned batching back to conservative settings during rollout.
Sam: 10m after rollout start: 5xx down to 0.7%, p95 latency back to normal.
Maria: taking final ownership to close PD if metrics stable for 20m. prep notes for postmortem: root cause likely regression in quantized model path + insufficient canary gating for rollout. action items: stricter canary SLOs, auto-fallback routing, add OOM alert before 5xx threshold.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page resolved (7081234597).
Maria: closing thread — moving to postmortem channel and creating a runbook PR for hotvector fallback. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
Jonas: good job team.
Priya: adding retro notes and runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hotvector-fallback
Sam: marking metrics snapshot and saving logs to incident bucket.
Alex: support notified and top customers emailed.
Maria: last note for record: total incident duration ~ 32m, peak impacted RPM ~1.2k, no data loss, follow-up items assigned.
